aggregation_policy.case_weights: equal weight; three-batch aggregate has 18/12/6 cases for all/small/large scopes
aggregation_policy.geometric_mean: geometric mean of per-case time ratios
aggregation_policy.p95: retained for every arm and case; not pooled or aggregated
aggregation_policy.ratio: candidate p50_ms divided by reference p50_ms
aggregation_policy.stage: reported independently; never subtracted from full-forward timing
aggregation_policy.worst_case: largest casewise time ratio; every case ratio and every regression is retained

interpretation_limits: No statistical confidence intervals are provided.
This repeat is not a holdout claim.
No production deployment, full-model quality, or Marlin superiority claim is made.
format_forward_change_vs_original_bf16 reports format loss and is not judged against the 0.008 kernel error limits.
The no_jit label applies only to startup native C++ extension loading; Triton preparation may still compile kernels outside this scope.

load_prepare_difference.batch1: The original worker used legacy cpp_extension.load preparation.
load_prepare_difference.batches2_3: The adapter directly loaded the audited native shared libraries before starting the frozen worker.
load_prepare_difference.no_jit_scope: verified_native_binary_no_jit describes only startup native C++ extension loading; it does not claim that Triton preparation in the worker compiles nothing.
load_prepare_difference.timing: Both load/preparation phases occur before the measured rounds and are excluded from the timing samples.

small_graph_reproduction.strict_rule: Each batch's small-four full_graph time-ratio geometric mean must be strictly below 1.0.

startup_verification.scope: startup native binary loading only; worker Triton preparation is outside this scope

all_18.case_weights: equal weight per case across the three batches

large_6.case_weights: equal weight per case across the three batches

small_12.case_weights: equal weight per case across the three batches
